payment.title: Payment
payment.intro: Pay for this order online by card on the page of our payment provider. This site never sees or stores your card details.
payment.awaiting: If the order is not paid by {time}, it is cancelled automatically.
payment.status.label: Payment status
payment.failure.declined: The bank declined the payment. You can try again or use another card.
payment.failure.expired: The payment link expired. Start a new payment to continue.
payment.failure.technical: A technical problem stopped the payment. You can try again.
payment.failure.not_accepted: A payment arrived, but the order could not accept it (for example it came too late). It is refunded or settled by the shop. Contact the shop if you have questions.
payment.redirecting: Taking you to the payment page. If nothing happens, check your connection and try again.
payment.error.title: The payment could not be started
payment.error.noPage: The payment page could not be opened. Please try again.
payment.error.processing: Your payment is already being processed. Check its status in a moment.
payment.error.paymentInProgress: A payment for this order is already in progress. Wait a moment, then check the payment status.
payment.error.notPayable: This order can no longer be paid: it was paid, cancelled or expired. The order below shows its current status.
payment.error.unavailable: Online payment is not available for this order right now. The shop will contact you to arrange payment.
payment.error.providerRetry: The payment service did not accept the request. You can try again.
payment.error.providerWait: The payment service did not confirm the request. Do not start another payment. Wait, then check the payment status; if you paid, the order updates by itself.
payment.error.keyReused: The request could not be repeated. Please try again.
payment.error.insecureContext: Online payment needs a secure connection (HTTPS). Open the shop over HTTPS.
payment.error.storage: Your browser does not allow this page to remember the payment. After you pay, open your order link again to see the result.
payment.wait.one: You can try again in {count} second.
payment.wait.other: You can try again in {count} seconds.
payment.return.title: Payment result
payment.return.waiting.title: Waiting for the payment
payment.return.waiting.body: We have not received the result yet. If you completed the payment, this page updates by itself.
payment.return.processing.title: Your payment is being processed
payment.return.processing.body: The bank is processing the payment. This usually takes a few seconds. You do not need to pay again.
payment.return.paid.title: Payment received
payment.return.paid.body: Thank you. The shop has received your payment and will take your order from here.
payment.return.failed.title: The payment did not go through
payment.return.expired.title: The payment link expired
payment.return.timedOut.title: Still waiting for the bank
payment.return.timedOut.body: The bank has not confirmed the payment yet. You do not need to do anything: the order updates by itself when it does. You can check again now or come back to the order later.
payment.return.error.title: The result could not be loaded
payment.return.noEntry.title: Open your order to see the result
payment.return.noEntry.body: This page cannot tell which order you paid for (for example, it was opened in another browser or on another device). Open the order link you saved, or sign in to your account. If you paid, the order updates by itself.
payment.return.notFound.title: Payment not found
payment.return.notFound.body: We could not find this payment. Open your order from the link you saved after ordering, or contact the shop.
payment.return.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in to see the payment.
payment.return.contact: If you have questions about a payment, contact the shop.
payment.return.signedOut.title: Sign in to see the payment
